description: Policy is set explicitly here rather than inherited from
github>unional/renovate-preset. As of 2026-09-01 that preset publishes only
soak, no packageRules -- and config:base is Renovate's deprecated name for
config:recommended. Extending it produced dependency PRs that never merged.
Exit condition: once unional/renovate-preset publishes the baseline policy,
collapse this file back to a single extends of that preset.
